  stratify_by:
    label: "Stratify column"
    value: NULL
  relative_to:

  nplot:
    label: "Number to plot"
    value: 15
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r run-analysis, echo=FALSE}
gfa_result <- driveanalytics::gen_frequency_analysis(params$df_rdv, params$df_pde, params$event_col, params$stratify_by)
gca_result <- driveanalytics::gen_correlation_analysis(gfa_result, params$relative_to)
gca_result <- head(gca_result, params$nplot, "rr_value", params$order_by)
```

# Most Correlated - `r params$input_name`

<!-- ## Overview -->
<!-- This report contains an analysis of the `r params$input_name` with the greatest strength of association between patients with your selected criteria. -->

## Relative Risk Plot
Visualisation of the `r params$nplot` highest scores for the relative risk of `r params$input_name` in cohort `r params$order_by` relative to cohort `r params$relative_to`.

```{r plot, echo=FALSE, fig.dim = c(8, 8), out.width="100%"}
plot(gca_result)
```

\pagebreak
## Relative Risk Data
Data for the `r params$nplot` highest scores for the relative risk of `r params$input_name` in cohort `r params$order_by` relative to cohort `r params$relative_to`.

```{r table, echo=FALSE}
render_output_type <- knitr::opts_knit$get('rmarkdown.pandoc.to')
driveanalytics::tabulate(gca_result, render_output_type)
```
